items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: Speaking of composers, there are so many of them like Pierone and Clarence Williams.

ctx.x: I still play it. In fact, I play Don't Leave Me Daddy too.

That's something that you don't hear too many men playing today. You're in jail. It's a good tune. Speaking of composers, there are so many of them like Pierone and Clarence Williams. Of course, I still play a lot of Clarence Williams' tunes. In fact, he had that publishing house on Tulane Avenue on the 1300 block. And he was in the I'm going to have to dig up the files on my birthplace. I might have been somewhere around that way that I was born. I know it was on Tulane Avenue somewhere.
Maybe you heard him playing and got it.
